description: Deterministically scores one product page (schema, price, availability, image) 0–100 for shopping-agent readability — no LLM, fully repeatable. Use when you want a precise, single-page readability score for a specific product URL rather than a whole-site audit. Available on Pro+ plans. Result: { result: { readability_score, ... }, tool_schema_version }.

brand.description: Optional brand/company name; inferred from the domain when absent.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the target (any public domain).

name: scan_product_page

bot_accessible.description: Whether the page is reachable by bots.
